item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Merge drafts against their original revision","mechanism":"Compare the loaded baseline, local draft, and latest server document to distinguish independent edits from conflicts.","implementation":"Retain baseline values and revision. After stale-save rejection, carry forward one-sided changes; flag differing changes to the same field.","check":"Edits to separate fields survive without retyping; identical edits need no resolution; divergent edits are flagged.","risk":"Missing baseline data must trigger review, not guessed merges."},{"action":"Replace the warning with field-level resolution","mechanism":"An inline resolution screen isolates conflicting fields while preserving automatically combined edits elsewhere.","implementation":"Show baseline, this-tab, and saved values. Provide labeled single-choice selectors and editable text results; require explicit conflict confirmation.","check":"Users resolve every conflict in one tab without dragging or copying between windows; merged results remain unpublished.","risk":"Truncated previews can conceal differences; provide expandable complete values."},{"action":"Resolve long text at the changed passage","mechanism":"Three-way text comparison separates independent passage edits from overlapping changes within one field.","implementation":"Combine disjoint changes in a preview; show overlapping passages side by side with keep-either, keep-both, and edit controls. Retain originals.","check":"Separate-paragraph edits survive; overlapping deletions require review; keep-both inserts both passages without clipboard use.","risk":"Textually disjoint edits may conflict semantically; require preview confirmation."},{"action":"Preserve recoverable versions before replacing text","mechanism":"A recovery history makes text excluded during resolution retrievable rather than silently lost.","implementation":"Before applying resolutions, persist baseline, local, fetched, and resolved text snapshots. Expose restore-as-draft controls; block replacement if preservation fails.","check":"Reload after resolution and recover either original text in the same tab without changing published content.","risk":"Stored text needs access controls and an explicit retention policy."},{"action":"Recheck the revision when saving resolved drafts","mechanism":"Resolution uses conditional saving so another intervening save cannot be overwritten by an outdated merge.","implementation":"Submit the resolved draft against its fetched revision. On rejection, preserve it and repeat comparison using that fetched document as baseline.","check":"A third save during resolution causes another comparison, preserves reviewed edits, and never automatically publishes.","risk":"Repeated contention can require multiple review rounds; never force overwrite."},{"action":"Warn other tabs without replacing their drafts","mechanism":"Same-browser save notifications reveal stale tabs early while server revisions remain authoritative.","implementation":"Broadcast document ID and saved revision after successful saves. Show a nonblocking review banner in other tabs; never replace their text automatically.","check":"A dirty receiving tab retains its input. With notifications disabled or missed, stale-save rejection still invokes full resolution.","risk":"Notifications are advisory and may expose document identifiers locally."},{"action":"Test late edits in an already stale tab","mechanism":"Revision-based regression tests prevent last-edit timestamps from incorrectly determining which draft should win.","implementation":"Open two tabs at revision N. Save A, then edit stale B afterward and save B. Exercise text and single-choice conflicts.","check":"B is rejected as stale; both versions remain recoverable, independent edits survive, only conflicts require resolution, and nothing auto-publishes.","risk":"Timing-only tests are flaky; coordinate events with explicit barriers."}],"abstention_reason":""}
